entities.summary: Gwen Teirbron was a Breton holy woman and wife of Fragan, believed to have lived in the 5th or 6th century. As a prominent figure in early Christian Brittany, she was revered for her piety and devotion to the Christian faith. Her epithet, 'of the three breasts,' reflects her association with the Holy Trinity. Gwen Teirbron's significance extends to the regional history of Brittany, where her legacy has been passed down through the centuries. Her story serves as a testament to the enduring power of faith and the importance of preserving cultural heritage. In the annals of world history, Gwen Teirbron's name remains an important chapter in the narrative of early Christianity in Western Europe.
